question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Mischivious."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The incorrectly spelt word is **"**Mischivious." • The correct spelling of the word is** "mischievous"**. • The word means causing or showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful way. ((प्रायः बच्‍चों के लिए प्रयुक्त) शरारती, नटखट) • **Example**: *She has a **mischievous**__ smile.* • The word is derived from the Middle English word **"meschief",** which means trouble or harm. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 - Gaiety**: This word means a state or quality of being lighthearted or cheerful. (ख़ुशी और मौज-मस्‍ती की भावना) • **Option 2 - Neigh**: This word means the characteristic sound made by a horse. (घोड़े की हिनहिनाहट) • **Option 4 - Inoculate**: This word means to give a vaccine or medicine to prevent disease. (मनुष्‍य या पशु को इंजेक्‍शन लगाकर उसका रोग से बचाव करना, बीमारी से बचाव के लिए मनुष्‍य या पशु को टीका लगाना) 36:T909, The correct answer is** "brake; break."**
